summary: The product holds fewer standing rights, and the install checks your access before it starts.

new.title: Write rights only while needed
new.text: Entra Policy Suite now reads users and devices with read-only rights, and holds write rights only while a feature that writes is on. The setup checks show which right is needed.

new.title: Install checks your access first
new.text: Before it creates anything, the install checks your Azure and Entra roles and the region's capacity, and lists everything missing at once.

new.title: Pro: clean-up disables only when allowed
new.text: Stale identities disables approved accounts only while a new SuperAdmin setting allows it. The setting is off by default.

fixes.title: Clear stop when a right is missing
fixes.text: Creating a break-glass account without the needed right now stops, names the right and shows how to grant it.
